exclusions.source_text: Participants must be 18 years of age or older.
Pregnant women are excluded from this study because agents released by the microdevice have the potential for teratogenic or abortifacient effects.

Because there is an unknown but potential risk for adverse events in nursing infants secondary to treatment of the mother with the agents used in this study, breastfeeding should be discontinued if the mother is treated in the study for a total of 14 days after removal of the microdevice.
